heading: Fee for use of diplomatic reception rooms
lead: The Secretary, acting through the Under Secretary for Management, is authorized to charge a fee for use of the diplomatic reception rooms of the Department of State. Amounts collected under this section (including reimbursements and surcharges) shall be deposited as an offsetting collection to any Department of State appropriation to recover the costs of such use and shall remain available for obligation until expended.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2025—Pub. L. 119–60 substituted “The Secretary, acting through the Under Secretary for Management,” for “The Secretary”.

notes.heading: Definition
notes.text: For definition of “Department” as used in this section, see section 5002 of Pub. L. 119–60, set out as a note under section 2651 of this title.
